title: Readback intent v0.1
description: What a signer said they are about to sign, recorded faithfully. Never what the transaction does.

amount.description: The number said, as a plain number. "a hundred" is 100, "half" is 0.5. Null if none said.

token.description: The asset being spent or sent, as a ticker or name. Null if none said.

token_out.description: For swaps and buys, the asset wanted in return. Null otherwise.

recipient.description: Who receives it, or for Safe administration the owner, module or guard involved: in the signer's words, or a 0x address if one was read out. "me" for themselves. Null if not said.

confirm.description: True only when the signer is plainly confirming, not describing a transaction.
